verdict.rationale: The pack has no explicit no-training policy or opt-out control. The only indirect route is self-hosted or on-prem deployment: the solution page targets "compliance-first organizations requiring secure on-premises deployment," and OCR 4 can run in a single container, keeping document data in your own environment. That would keep data away from the vendor, but it is an enterprise deployment workaround rather than a stated training guarantee. missing for 10: an explicit policy that API or Le Chat data is not used for training, a documented opt-out or zero-retention setting, Trust Center content on training use, independent corroboration.
